source.title: Good Steel
source.description: Good steel is in short supply after the war, and our tools have suffered for it. The Jasperlode miners used finely-crafted picks, and I imagine some of them are still there in the depths of the mine. Could you retrieve some for me, and I'll see if I can repurpose the steel?
source.objective: Collect 4 Mining Tools from Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hagar Lowe in Eastvale Logging Camp.
